name: low_strings
character: A broad low string section swelling under the piano, closer to a slow tide than a pad: it breathes in on the bar line and lets go before the next change.
description: The bed: string ensemble in three- and four-note low voicings, an unbroken sustained layer that widens at the crush and thins to a bare fifth at the horizon.
sources: KB cinematic-hybrid-scoring section 1 | sustained strings are the bed the pressure rides on; the bed itself must not carry the pulse
KB soundfont-velocity-and-realism section 4 | velocity_timbre makes the quiet bars warmer than the crush instead of just quieter; starting values
ESTIMATE: azimuth 14 deg, 28 deg up, 3.4 m, gain -8 dB and 40 percent room send are starting values for a section heard from inside a large field
